title: Picraftyune Dreams
description: Adds items and mobs from Picayune Dreams.
body:
Requires Neoforge for 1.21.8

WARNING!!! This mod contains spoilery spoilers for Picayune Dreams! 

(This mod probably won't get any new enemies or bosses for some time. Idk how to model the enemies, or how to make the bosses.)

Content this mod adds:
Armors:
-Worn Suit
-Default Suit
-Perfected Suit
-Picayune Suit
-(Creative Only) "Golden" Suit

Enemies:
-Soul
-Gloves
-Exploder
-Rabbit
-Worm
-Demon
-Picayune
-Umi
-Aberrated Demon
-Ghost

Weapons (Each weapon has a "Picayune" variant:
-Chainsword
-Slime Spike
-Dagger Glove
-Reaper Scythe

Other things:
Advancements
Other Items
